standing_facts: Ashford is remote: the nearest town with a second healer is two days' walk.
Maren is the only healer; if she fails, there is no one else nearby.
Winter fevers here climb over successive nights; past the third night they rarely turn (craft lore, not law).
It is a close village — most people are in-group to one another; a traveler is a visible outsider.

locations.what: Maren's cottage at the village edge — her stores, her workbench, where she sleeps little
the village square — the well, the gathering place
a spare room off the square kept for the worst cases
the road out, toward the town two days off
